cohort: The study included 301 patients with inguinal hernia who underwent elective laparoscopic totally extraperitoneal (TEP) repair, 105 of whom had previously undergone lower abdominal surgery.
finding: Patients with a history of previous lower abdominal surgery had a significantly higher incidence of postoperative scrotal hematoma after TEP repair, although other intraoperative and postoperative outcomes, immediate and chronic pain, and hernia recurrence rates were found to be similar between groups.
